page.notes: The Greek words in the first line are only partly legible at this scan resolution; the Greek letters marked [?] are doubtful. The Greek word after "Ota-" (ὠτακουστὰς) is also doubtful. The Latin "sul" in "jura sul verti" is uncertain (it may be "fuit" or "sui"). The "V.ii." in the Aristotle citation may be misread.
